### CREDITS
This space platform is a personal modification of the original blueprint by **XtremeZion** ([View original on FactorioPrints](https://factorioprints.com)).

---

### CHANGELOG

#### v0.1 - Base Reconstruction
*   **Loader-free Design:** System is now fully belt-integrated; loaders are no longer required.
*   **Priority Logic:** Added conditional crafting. The "Everything" Mall now only activates when essential supplies reach "Normal" levels.
    1.  **Ammunition** (Base Defense) and **Water** (Nuclear Power / System Stability)
    2.  **Fuel** (Rocket Boosters / Logistics)
    3.  **The Mall** (General Crafting)

#### v0.2 - Control & Reliability
*   **Force Crafting Toggle:** Added a **Constant Combinator** for "Force Crafting." This allows users to bypass priority logic and start production immediately without manual circuit editing.
*   **Anti-Stuck Logic:** Implemented circuit-controlled belt management to prevent asteroid jamming, ensuring a smooth flow even under heavy load.

#### v0.3 (Latest) - Final Polish
*   **Minor Fixes:** Corrected several small layout and circuit issues for better overall stability and reliability.

---

> *Note: Production in the Mall is gated behind the stabilization of ammunition, water, and booster fuel levels unless "Force Crafting" is active.*
